versions.changelog:
- Initial release of logos-and-vectors skill.
- Generate or convert true, editable SVG vector graphics (logos, icons, illustrations, glyphs) that scale cleanly and open in design tools.
- Offers both vector generation from description and high-quality raster-to-SVG conversion using Recraft and Picsart models.
- Provides workflow guidance, including color palette locking and text handling (recommending `text-in-image` for accurate wordmarks).
- Ensures outputs are real SVG vectors, not raster images in SVG wrappers.
- Includes quality standards and technique notes for getting the best vector results.
